title: phpMyFAQ 4.1.9 before 4.1.12 and 4.2.0-alpha before 4.2.0-RC.2 contains an account enumeration vulnerability that…
description: phpMyFAQ versions 4.1.9 before 4.1.12 and 4.2.0-alpha before 4.2.0-RC.2 have an account enumeration vulnerability. This flaw allows unauthenticated attackers to distinguish valid usernames by analyzing different responses from the POST /api/webauthn/prepare endpoint. Attackers can exploit this by submitting username wordlists using a single CSRF token without rate limiting, enabling discovery of administrator accounts for further attacks such as password spraying or phishing.
